review:
This game is great - couldn't stop playing the demo and now buying it.
Its a nice simple football management game with a tactical match as the centrepiece.

The game indroduces elements gradually until you begin to realise its totally addictive.

This has potential! I like the turn-based element and it seems reasonably well implemented. I don't think the current system is perfect in how it has not enough player interaction per game to really get a game flowing in a less random way. I can accept the game is a little dice based, but it's not much fun when you essentially get only one shot per turn, let alone hardly a few shots per game on target, seeing there's quite little you can do to maximise shot efficiency. The game also seems to encourage not moving your players unless you can steal or grab the ball (you simply don't have the turns to 'waste'). I'm not sure how a turn-based game of football without the dynamics of lines of players moving around can really work. It probably needs a more similar approach like Bloodbowl has where you actually need to cross one side of the pitch, with a bit more space that aren't automatically guarded. Yes in a sense this game is being played in 'constant grid lock' positions if you know what I mean. 


As for various other things, it does have very smooth a good animations. It has a fairly solid system of determining chance, whilst also giving the player a hint of what the maximum potential of any situation is. I would have liked a little bit more information on when your opponent is less likely to have max defense potential. It seems a bit random whether or not a line of defense with a goalkeeper can still be passed with mediocre odds, despite a goalkeeper having a 40+ defense value (my strikers usually have like 20 or less). I understand that 40 is simply the max value the goalkeeper can roll, but unless I've missed something I've got no clue when my player will do better than average or when the goalkeeper is likely not to stop a shot. In short, this probably needs to be less random somehow. At least in terms of player interaction.


I would recommend people checking this game out. It deserves a chance.
